verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
¿Tas yuj hanheja' heyalub'tanhan jun lolonel t'a spatik chonhab' Israel: Ha heb' mamab'il slo pajal uwa heb', haxo heb' uninab'il jululixonhej sb'at spajil chi' t'a yichtak ye heb'?
Ha hin Jehová Yajal hin swala' to ha jun lolonel chi' manhxa b'ak'inh ol heyalub'tanhej ha hex aj Israel hex tik.
Yujto wik yaj masanil anima, heb' mamab'il yet' pax heb' uninab'il. Ha mach tz'och smul, ha' schami.
K'inalok ay junok winh winak tojol spensar, wach'nhej tas sk'ulej winh.

Max och winh yet' heb' tz'ak'anoch k'inh t'a jolomtak witz yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Max yak'och juntzanh skomon diosal heb' yetisraelal winh chi' yipok sk'o'ol. Max mulan winh yet' ix yetb'eyum junok yetanima'il, max yil-laj sb'a winh yet' ix yetb'eyum ayik ayoch ix t'a sb'islab' uj.
Max yixtej junok yetanima'il winh, palta to syak' meltzaj tas aykan t'a winh yuj junok anima ay sb'ok t'ay. Max elk'anwi winh. Syak' swa'el heb' ay swejel winh, syak'an spichul heb' malaj yiko'.

Max yak' k'e'en tumin winh t'a majanil yik sk'ananel niwan yune' k'e'en winh. Max yixtej junok yetanima'il winh, palta wach' tz'aj sb'o'an yaj junok lolonel winh t'a yib'anh chawanhok ay owal t'a skal.
Sb'eyb'alan hin cheknab'il winh yet' hin k'ayb'ub'al. Ha junok winh winak icha chi', wal yel tojol ton sb'eyb'al winh, ol najatb'ok sk'inal winh, ha hin wal Jehová hin swala'.
K'inalok ay junok yuninal jun winh winak chi' te elk'um, mato mak'umcham anima tz'aji. Sb'eyb'alej juntzanh tastak
maj sb'eyb'alej smam, palta to syak'och k'inh t'a jolomtak witz, tz'och ejmelal t'a yechel komon Dios, smulan pax yet' ix yetb'eyum junok yetanima'il,

syixtan heb' anima ilb'ajk'o'ol yuj smeb'a'il, tz'elk'anwi, max yak' meltzaj tas aykan t'ay yuj heb' ay sb'ok t'ay, anhej juntzanh komon Dios chi' syak'och yipok sk'o'ol, sk'ulan tas te yajb'entak t'a wichanh.

Ha stumin syak' majanil te niwan yune' sk'ana'. Ha junok anima icha chi' sb'eyb'al, ol tzapanb'ok sk'inal. Yujto ix sk'ulej juntzanh tastak tzin yaj chi', manh ol ek'b'atlaj schami. Ha schamel chi', ha t'a yib'anh skani.
K'inalok ay junok yuninal jun winak chuk sb'eyb'al chi', syila' tastak juntzanh chuk sk'ulej smam chi', palta manhok juntzanh chi' sk'ulej.
Max yak'och k'inh t'a jolomtak witz yik tz'och ejmelal t'a yechel komon Dios. Max yak'och son t'a juntzanh skomon diosal heb' yetisraelal. Max mulan yet' ix yetb'eyum junok yetanima'il.
Max yixtej junok yetanima'il, max elk'anwi, max kanlaj tas aykan t'ay yuj heb' ay sb'ok t'ay. Syak' swa'el heb' malaj swa'el, syak'an spichul heb' malaj yiko'.

Malaj junok mach syixtej yujto ha stumin syak' majanil manh niwanok yune' sk'ana'. Sb'eyb'alan hin cheknab'il yet' hin k'ayb'ub'al. Ha jun anima icha chi', manh ol cham yuj smul smam chi', palta to ol najatb'ok sk'inal.
Haxo smam chi' ol cham yuj smul chi', yujto ixtum anima, elk'um, te chuk tas ix sk'ulej t'a yol schonhab'.

Tato ayex ol he k'anb'ej icha tik: ¿Tas yuj max kotkan t'a yib'anh heb' uninab'il yuj smul smam? tato xe chi. Tato ha yuninal chi' anhej tas wach' yet' tojolal sk'ulej, sk'anab'ajan hin k'ayb'ub'al, ol najatb'ok sk'inal.

Ha mach tz'och smul, ha ol chamok. Manhok heb' uninab'il ol tupanel smul smam, manhok pax heb' mamab'il chi' ol tupanel smul heb' yuninal chi'. Ha mach wach' sb'eyb'al, wach' spak ol scha'a, haxo pax mach chuk sb'eyb'al, ha chukal ol scha spakok schukal chi'.
Tato ay junok anima chuk sb'eyb'al tz'aktankan schukal chi', sb'eyb'alan masanil hin cheknab'il, sb'eyb'alanpax tojolal, wal yel ha jun anima chi' manh ol pet chamok.
Ha hin tik, manhxo ol hin nakot juntzanh chukal ix sk'ulej chi', ol najatb'ok sk'inal yujto ha tojolal sk'ulej.
Ha hin Jehová hin swala': Malaj hin gana scham heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, palta hin gana to sk'ex sb'eyb'al heb' yik snajatb'i sk'inal heb'.

Tato ha junok anima wach' sb'eyb'al, palta syaktejkan sk'ulan wach'il chi', haxo juntzanh tas yajb'entak sk'ulej heb' chuk, ha chi' sk'ulej, ¿tom ol wak' najatb'ok sk'inal jun anima chi' tze na'a? Manhxo ol hin nakot tastak wach' ix sk'ulej chi'. Ol cham yuj chukal sk'ulej chi'.
Ha hex tik tzeyala' to manh tojolok tas tzin k'ulej, yuj chi' ab'ek hex aj Israel: ¿Yel am wal to manh tojolok tas tzin k'ulej chi'? ¿Tom manhok hex tze k'ulej tas manh tojolok chi' jun?
Tato ha junok anima wach' sb'eyb'al, syaktejkan sk'ulan wach'il chi', haxo chukal sk'ulej, ol cham yuj chukal sk'ulej chi'.
Palta tato ha junok anima chuk sb'eyb'al, syaktejkan schukal chi', haxo wach'il yet' tojolal sk'ulej, ol kolchaj t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Yujto ix nachajel yuj ix yaktankan schukal sk'ulej chi', wal yel manh ol chamlaj, ol najatb'ok sk'inal.
Ha hexxo aj Israel hex tik, hanhejtona' tzeyala' to manh tojolok tas tzin k'ulej. ¿Tom manhok hex manh tojolok tas tze k'ulej chi' jun?

Ha hin Jehová Yajal hin swala': Ol hex hin ch'olb'itej junjun hex icha tas tze k'ulej. Yuj chi' na'ek he b'a, aktejekkan he chuk b'eyb'al chi' t'a jun'elnhej. Tato ma'ay, yuj he chuk b'eyb'alil chi' ol hex satelok.
Hex israel, ¿tom tze nib'ej cham he b'a yuj chi' max he k'ex he pensar yet' he b'eyb'al? Palta aktejekkan masanil chukal tze k'ulej chi' yik manh ol hex chamok.
Ha hin Jehová hin swala', malaj hin gana to ay mach schami. Aktejekkan chukal chi' yik ol najatb'ok he k 'inal, xchi Jehová.
